transcript.text: Good afternoon, everyone. I've called us together to discuss the first-year composition program's proposal to pilot an AI writing-feedback platform in two sections next term. Before I can make a binding decision on whether this pilot proceeds and under what conditions, I need to make sure we've gone through our routine review process. Specifically, I'd like to hear from both the writing program and the privacy office regarding any instructional or data-handling requirements we should be aware of. Could we start with the writing program's perspective on the instructional side of this proposal?

transcript.text: I should share that just this week, I finalized our writing program's adopted pilot standard for this platform. It permits the platform only for formative feedback, requires an instructor to review every generated suggestion before it is released to a student, and prohibits using the platform to assign or determine grades. This standard has not yet been added to the proposal packet, so I want to make sure everyone here is aware of it before we proceed.
